description: This file defines the 'Image_Graph_Layout' class, an abstract class for layout elements within the Image_Graph PEAR package. It manages layout calculations, coordinate updates, and edge pushing for graph layout elements.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout
classes.description: An abstract class for layout elements in the Image_Graph package, providing methods for coordinate calculation, edge alignment, and layout management.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout element and sets default padding.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the layout element's state, including the '_updated' flag.

methods.name: _calcEdgeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for a specific edge based on alignment size, total size, and multiplier.

methods.name: _calcEdges
methods.description: Calculates the positions of the edges based on alignment and parent fill areas.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the element's coordinates by recalculating edges and calling parent update.

methods.name: _push
methods.description: Sets alignment size for an edge, either in percentage or pixels.

methods.name: _setCoords
methods.description: Sets the element's coordinates and marks it as updated.

methods.name: _getAutoSize
methods.description: Returns false, indicating no automatic sizing calculation.
